_comment: The texts of each autonomous community as an Unciv nation, in each language: the name of its unique (a bonus on the resource it holds most of, relative to its size), the text Unciv shows when a game starts, and what the page and the README say of it (its advantage, its start bias in Unciv's own terrain names, a city-state's type). English is the mod's own text (jsons/Nations.json) and Spanish its translation (jsons/translations/Spanish.properties). Filled in by pipeline/play.py from unciv.json's summary.

es.intro: $name: $population habitantes en $municipalities municipios (INE, Padrón $year). Empiezas en $capital. En este mapa tienes $land_tiles casillas de tierra, y en tu tierra y tu costa hay $resource_tiles de las $resource_map_tiles casillas de $resource_lower del mapa: tus ciudades sacan una más de comida, producción y oro de cada una que trabajen.

en.intro: $name: $population people in $municipalities municipalities (INE, Padrón $year). You start in $capital. On this map you have $land_tiles land tiles, and your land and coast hold $resource_tiles of the map's $resource_map_tiles $resource_lower tiles: your cities get one more food, production and gold from each one they work.
